compositionRules.assert: Empty_state patterns SHOULD compose a Title (emphasis) with a secondary Paragraph (description) rather than a single text node, to convey both absence and guidance.
Heading variants (h1/h2/h3) MUST be nested in document order and SHOULD NOT skip levels (no h1 -> h3) to preserve semantic document structure.

bad: {"variant":"h3","text":"Dashboard"} after skipping an h1/h2 in the outline (broken heading order)
Using a heading variant for a one-line instruction that is not a section title
Wrapping a large interactive block as Typography text instead of a button/link when an action is intended
good: {"variant":"body","text":"默认对账周期为 T+1，可在此调整。"}
empty_state: a Title "暂无数据" plus a secondary Paragraph "创建你的第一条记录以开始" composed together

hardRules.message: Typography.variant must be one of h1, h2, h3, body, secondary.
Typography requires non-empty string children; an empty text node provides no content anchor.
Empty_state intent must compose at least two Typography nodes (title + description) to express absence with guidance.
Typography text fill must bind only to color.text.default or color.text.secondary token.
Typography exposes no layout slots; it renders text content only.

meaning.definition: Renders textual content with a clear role in the content hierarchy — headings to name a section or decision context, body to convey the substance, and secondary text to de-emphasize supporting or meta information. As an empty_state pattern it composes a title with a description to communicate the absence of data while orienting the user toward a next action.
doNotUseWhen: An action is the primary intent (use Button) or navigation is required (use Menu/Link).
Long-form structured documentation spanning many paragraphs (prefer a dedicated document/article layout).
Displaying status that should be glanceable at a distance (use Tag/Badge/Alert).
useWhen: Naming a section or decision context via a heading (h1/h2/h3).
Presenting the main readable substance of a screen or card.
Conveying meta, helper, timestamp, or de-emphasized secondary information.
Composing an empty_state with a concise title plus a secondary description and next step.

contentRules: Must be a non-empty string for heading variants.
May be empty string only for secondary helper text that intentionally carries no content.
children.description: Text content to render. Headings and body require meaningful non-empty text; secondary text may carry de-emphasized meta or helper content.

variant.description: Content role in the hierarchy: h1/h2/h3 name a section or decision context, body conveys the main readable substance, secondary de-emphasizes meta/helper information.

softRules: Prefer the 'secondary' variant for timestamps, helper text, and footnotes rather than graying out body text manually.
Keep heading text concise and noun- or action-oriented so it names the section's decision context.
In empty_state, keep the title short (one phrase) and put the explanation/guidance in the secondary description.
Do not use a heading variant to label a single control; use the control's own label instead.

semantics.body: main readable content of the current context
semantics.secondary: de-emphasized meta, helper, or supporting text
